what: On hover the band is painted from the left edge with scaleX 0→1 over .6s, and on release it is wiped away toward the right edge (origin left when entering, right when leaving — it passes through instead of rewinding along the same path). The ‹line› type is a 2px underline 8px below the text — header menu links. The band type puts a white fill behind the whole row — large row links. The arrow bar inside a row (data-fx-part=If there is a bar), it stretches to the same length

options.--fx-fill: Band color (via style), default var(--kf-surface) · line type is currentColor
options.--fx-bar: Arrow bar width on hover, default 54px (original 42→54rem)
options.look: “line” — a 2px underline below the text (data-fx-sweep-through-hover="look: line")
options.[data-fx-part=band]: Band (child) — if none, ::before becomes the band
options.--fx-line-y: look: line underline position (from the text’s bottom edge, via style), default -8px — Brand -1px
options.--fx-line-h: look: line underline thickness (via style), default 2px — Brand 1px
options.grow: ‹width› — stretches by width instead of scaleX: at rest the width is 0 and stuck to the right, on hover it grows to 100% anchored to the left, and on release it shrinks back toward the right (same as look: line — the 5px bar above the Brand header menu, --fx-line-y: calc(100% - 5px))
options.--fx-dur-in: A different duration only on entering (when hovered) (via style), default --fx-dur — Brand pill button .66s (.6s on leaving)
options.--fx-ease-in: A different curve only when entering (via style), default --fx-ease — the original uses cubic-bezier(.1,1,.7,1) (when leaving: .15,1,.7,1)
